from datetime import datetime

# Prepare tokens/paths
fs_access_token = fs_token

way_back_dir = '~/photographs/way_back/'

# Ensure downloads directory exists
downloads_dir = '~/downloads'
if not apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=downloads_dir, access_token=fs_access_token).get('exists', False):
    apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=downloads_dir, access_token=fs_access_token, recursive=True)

# Create a unique zip filename to avoid collisions
stamp = datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')
zip_path = f'{downloads_dir}/old_pics_{stamp}.zip'

print('Compressing:', way_back_dir, '->', zip_path)

# Compress directory into zip
compress_res = apis.file_system.compress_directory(
    directory_path=way_back_dir,
    access_token=fs_access_token,
    compressed_file_path=zip_path
)
print('compress_res:', compress_res)
zip_abs_path = compress_res.get('compressed_file_path')
print('zip_abs_path:', zip_abs_path)
print('zip_path_is_abs:', zip_abs_path.startswith('/'))

# Fetch parent emails (paginated)
page_index = 0
parent_contacts = []
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(
        access_token=phone_token,
        relationship='parent',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not resp:
        break
    parent_contacts.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
parent_emails = [c.get('email') for c in parent_contacts if c.get('email')]
print('parent_contacts_count:', len(parent_contacts))
print('parent_emails_count:', len(parent_emails))
print('parent_emails:', parent_emails)

# Zip path from earlier compression
print('zip_abs_path:', zip_abs_path)

# Ensure gmail access token exists; login only if needed
try:
    gmail_access_token = _gmail_token
except NameError:
    gmail_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
    gmail_login_res = apis.gmail.login(username='ma_smith@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)
    gmail_access_token = gmail_login_res.get('access_token')

# Send email
send_res = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=parent_emails,
    subject='Old Pics',
    body='PFA.',
    access_token=gmail_access_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[zip_abs_path],
    file_system_access_token=fs_access_token
)
print('send_res:', send_res)

# Verification: zip exists
zip_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=zip_abs_path, access_token=fs_access_token)
print('zip_exists:', zip_exists)
